Strategy: Aim for a leftover of thirty-five with a small Best Fit tiebreak, preferring bins closest to the middle of the good band and tighter ones among equals. It may help by centering on the best leftover, but may fail if the exact center rarely matches a real bin.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(r - item - 35) - (r - item) / 100 for r in bins]
```
